prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design an actual polished iOS app called Benchmate, a companion for guided physical making projects. Generate high-resolution realistic application screens, not ads. Exactly TWO flat front-facing 393x852 logical portrait app screens side by side with a small neutral gutter. Native status bars and home indicators, narrow screen boundaries, no thick phone hardware. Output only app screens: no presentation titles, no branding billboard outside them, no explanatory arrows outside the app, no poster lettering, no furniture/room scene.

User feedback: earlier ivory/orange with serif typography felt like Claude. Completely replace that visual identity. New palette: COOL PEARL #EAEBEF and soft graphite #24232B, restrained true VIOLET #754BB5 with pale orchid #C8AFDC. White and smoked lilac translucent glass. Absolutely NO beige, ivory, cream, amber, orange, brown, blue, cyan or teal interface accents. Gold is allowed only if showing actual printer build plate hardware. Use a normal-to-wide modern humanist sans throughout (SF Pro Text / Söhne-like normal width), open counters, uncompressed letterforms, regular weight body. No serif, condensed fonts or oversized headings. Logical font scale: page heading 25px, section heading 19px, body 16px, metadata 12px, controls 16px. Strong charcoal text on light surfaces, white on dark. Modest text density, plenty of space. Native touch target sizing. Single dominant action on task screens; browsing surfaces may expose a few clear choices.

GLASS + MATRIX MUST BE UNMISTAKABLE, MUCH STRONGER THAN BEFORE:
Within each image/artwork area, use the supplied video contact sheet ONLY for technique: a visible object-following field of tiny ASCII glyphs (dots, plus signs, colons, asterisks), true ordered dither shading and sparse sampling-grid lines. DO NOT use the video's warm palette, flowers, large serif lettering or poster layout. Two additional user references described here: the Claryx flower contributes soft underlying object color with luminous dot-character silhouettes; the ASCII flower contributes clear, intricate sampled contours over photographic/object imagery. Do not copy their brands, flowers or blue palette.
Render the actual 3D object transitioning from smooth satin solid material into a crisp volumetric character/dither representation across around one third of its form. Dense enough to read immediately as ASCII/dither, not just a decorative dotted border, random particles, stars, bokeh, snowfall or glow. Keep most of the object solid and recognizable. This is an expressive project-art treatment, NOT evidence of actual 3D scanning.
Make physical GLASS unmistakable: broad frosted translucent sheets overlap the lower 15–20% of rendered objects, with the object's orchid/graphite silhouette visibly blurred and optically displaced THROUGH the glass. Delicate double highlights at edges, restrained finely ribbed side edge, cloudy transmission, subtle refraction and material thickness. Real layered foreground/content surfaces, not generic opaque white rounded cards with shadows. Text on the glass stays dense and dark. No dithering on text, icons, controls or whole-screen background. Background remains light; dark image areas provide material contrast.

3D product identity: original seated little cat, broad simple head, pointed ears, calm minimal face, rounded body, curved tail around the front feet. Consistent sculptural satin pearl/orchid material with fine printed layer texture. Not a cartoon mascot or stuffed toy. Bambu X1-like printer is schematic graphite enclosed printer. This independent concept implies no manufacturer sponsorship. Additional project examples are labeled Preview and do not imply real printable files, guide availability, duration, temperatures or print validation.

Persistent iOS bottom tab bar is a visibly frosted floating pill with exactly TWO destination tabs: Home (simple outline house) and Collection (four small squares). Active destination uses a small graphite/violet marker and dark label; inactive softer. No extra chat, analytics, equipment-store or gamification dashboards. Discrete modest project progress is allowed, no points/streak/rewards clutter.

SCREEN LEFT — HOME, starting point, Home tab active.
Header: small 'benchmate' wordmark left and a quiet round profile icon right. Page heading 'Make something.' Small supportive copy 'A little guidance. A thing of your own.'
Small section label 'Your equipment'.
One major Bambu card, taking central half of screen: a clear schematic graphite X1-like printer emerging against an orchid/graphite image field, with a small satin pearl cat next to it. On the right side of the printer and cat silhouette, a sophisticated visible ASCII/dither transition follows actual form; do not replace the whole image. A substantial frosted lilac glass sheet overlaps its lower edge, visibly blurring objects behind it. Card title 'Bambu Lab', secondary 'Projects for your X1 Carbon'. Its single main charcoal pill action reads 'View projects' with an arrow. This button is the obvious route to the second screen.
Below, one compact text-and-thumbnail row 'Your collection' with 'Saved ideas and finished projects' and a quiet right chevron. Small cat thumbnail only, no second large CTA. Bottom two-tab dock with Home selected. Keep the navigation understandable to a first-time user. No giant welcome slogan, search maze, equipment catalog, status telemetry or fake live connection.

SCREEN RIGHT — BAMBU PROJECTS, reached by View projects. Home tab still active because this is its nested page.
Top back control reads 'Home', compact page title 'Bambu projects'. Small subtitle 'For your X1 Carbon'. No commercial partnership badges or Bambu logo required.
One prominent featured project card: same pearl/orchid 3D seated cat, around 220px image height, on soft graphite, one third of its right half translating into an intricate ivory/violet ASCII/dither point-field, sharp enough to see at phone size. Clear solid half remains. Frosted translucent lilac sheet across bottom of image: title 'Little cat', small descriptor 'Guided project', simple arrow at right. Whole card is the obvious entry to project detail; no nested duplicate Start/Explore buttons.
Below featured card, restrained label 'More ideas' then exactly TWO smaller preview cards in one row: a minimal 3D fluted tray labeled 'Ripple tray' / 'Preview'; and a simple sculptural cable holder labeled 'Cable pebble' / 'Preview'. Smaller representations may use subtle dither only, no visual competition with featured cat. They are conceptual placeholders, not downloadable existing projects. Two-tab dock remains Home active.
High-quality crisp interface rendering, open typography, tangible visible glass, obvious ASCII-shaded object form. Do not carry over any previous ivory/orange mockup.

Edit the supplied Benchmate Home/Bambu UI board. Preserve its successful cool-pearl/graphite/violet palette, normal-width sans fonts, beautiful pearl 3D cat, graphite printer, obvious character-matrix/dither object transition and thick translucent glass overlapping the object. Fix ONLY layout scale, viewport proportions and duplicated content.

CRITICAL OUTPUT GEOMETRY: the ENTIRE output is a WIDE composite, approximately 1280 pixels wide by 1120 pixels high, with two complete phone-screen rectangles side by side. Each screen is 480 pixels wide by 1040 pixels high (equivalent to an actual 393x852 iPhone viewport). Both rectangles share the same top and bottom and each has width/height about 0.46. No very tall screen, no full-page scrolling screenshot, no long white bottom extension. Generous plain neutral side margins are fine. Render exactly one visible phone viewport per screen. This output must be wider than it is tall. The source composition is too elongated; do not preserve its dimensions.

Scale all layout to a REAL 393x852 logical viewport:
Home: status bar y0-44, compact wordmark/profile y50-88; 25px heading 'Make something.' and 16px supporting copy y112-177; Your equipment label y199; ONE main image/glass card from y229 to570 (341px TOTAL, image and glass together). Retain the 3D printer + cat and one-third obvious ASCII/dither form, frosted sheet 'Bambu Lab', 'Projects for your X1 Carbon', ONE 'View projects' CTA. Fit it within that 341px height. Below at y606, ONLY one 70px horizontal 'Your collection' row with a tiny 48px cat thumbnail, supporting label 'Saved ideas and finished projects', and chevron. DELETE the extra large duplicate cat collection card. Bottom tab dock at y744-811, home indicator y832. Clear open space between row and dock is intentional.
Bambu page: status bar and back Home at top. 25px 'Bambu projects' title and subtitle 'For your X1 Carbon' by y164. Featured Little cat image/glass card at y188-538, total350px high; show exact same cat with striking character-field transition, glass with 'Little cat' / 'Guided project', single arrow. 'More ideas' small section label at y568. Two smaller preview cards side by side from y598-722, 124px tall TOTAL each: compact render plus 'Ripple tray' or 'Cable pebble', each tagged 'Preview'. Do not enlarge these. Bottom tab dock y744-811 and home indicator y832. Home active on both screens, Collection inactive.
Keep all type normal width, headings25px, body16px, labels12px AT LOGICAL PHONE SCALE. All controls at useful size. No added large text, duplicated captions, photos outside screens, manufacturer partnership claim or advertising title. Do not add devices beyond the TWO flat screen canvases.
This is a targeted proportion correction of the supplied current image, not an earlier warm design.

OUTPUT GEOMETRY FIRST: a wide composite image approximately 1340x1170, wider than tall. Exactly TWO flat iPhone screen canvases side by side, each approximately 503px wide x1090px high, matching a 393x852 logical viewport. Only one visible phone viewport per screen. No full-page scroll captures, no stretched tall phones, no long blank extension below. Match the supplied corrected Home/Bambu board's screen proportions and physical size. If content exceeds the viewport, reduce decorative image height, never stretch the screen.

Compact back link 'Bambu projects' at top; save bookmark control at upper right, saved state indicated with small violet fill. Page title 'Little cat'. Small subheading 'A small companion, made by you.'

Overlapping glass at bottom of image visibly transmits and distorts the cat silhouette.
Lower frosted sheet with concise metadata 'X1 Carbon · PLA'. Quiet source/status line 'Guided demo'. Both screens feel like pages in exactly the same real mobile app as the Home/Bambu pair.
